measure: The analysis pipeline, wired by hand: RepositoryValidator, the selected roots in MAIN, GENERATED, TEST order, a fresh cache, one RUNNING analysis, then SpoonModelBuilder.analyze with a CodeElementExtractor over an ElementWriter; every row is read back from code_element, source_file and source_root after end(), and the writes are timed by an ElementSink that wraps the ElementWriter

selections.DEFAULT: MAIN and GENERATED, no TEST: the analysis default and spoon-corpus.json's population

environment.storage: APPLE SSD AP1024Z internal NVMe SSD
environment.runtime: full JDK under Maven Surefire, not the jlink image the application ships
